CustomField.label: Hardware Region
CustomField.description: CR-15: Supported when the shipping (else billing) country is US, Canada, UK or Australia, or blank. Product qualification shows Mindbody hardware only for Supported accounts.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Supported = Mindbody hardware can be sold (US, Canada, UK, Australia). Based on the shipping country, else the billing country.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(BLANKVALUE(ShippingCountry, BillingCountry)), 'Supported', IF(CASE(UPPER(TRIM(BLANKVALUE(ShippingCountry, BillingCountry))), 'UNITED STATES', 1, 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', 1, 'USA', 1, 'US', 1, 'CANADA', 1, 'CA', 1, 'UNITED KINGDOM', 1, 'UK', 1, 'GB', 1, 'GREAT BRITAIN', 1, 'ENGLAND', 1, 'SCOTLAND', 1, 'WALES', 1, 'NORTHERN IRELAND', 1, 'AUSTRALIA', 1, 'AU', 1, 0) = 1, 'Supported', 'Not Supported') )
